description: Return a list of all Custom Field Lov Entries associated with the Current Company and the Custom Field Definition passed by path param.

parameters.name: custom_field_definition_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Custom Field Definition.

parameters.name: filters[start_with]
parameters.description: return lov entries with a label that starts with query string

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: return lov entries where the active status is (true or false)

parameters.name: filters[label_with]
parameters.description: return lov entries where the label contains the query string

data.description: Array of Custom Field LOV Entries

position.description: Position is sorted descending, highest position is visually the top of the list.

active.description: Whether or not the Custom Field Lov Entry is active
